Which features matter?

SSB lets you hear amateur, aviation and maritime voice traffic. Synchronous AM reduces fading distortion on broadcasts. An external antenna input matters more than most specs, because a few metres of wire outdoors beats any built-in whip. New to the hobby? Start with our beginner's guide.
